predeclared_interpretation.primary_descriptive_question: For H6 QR33 do all three available matched mean-loss changes favor QR, while at least one rolling comparison changes sign across the three windows? Evaluate exact mean scores, not a p-value threshold.
predeclared_interpretation.SUPPORT_WITH_LIMITS: All three H6 QR33 matched changes strictly negative and rolling signs contain both positive and negative; report only period/reference dependence conditional on overlapping inspected windows and later parameter choice.
predeclared_interpretation.MISMATCH: Any complete H6 QR33 matched change nonnegative weakens stability; if all rolling changes have same sign it does not support period-varying direction. Retain adverse values.
predeclared_interpretation.INCONCLUSIVE: Any required original H6 QR33/reference comparison is missing/failed; do not complete-case label stability.
predeclared_interpretation.secondary: H24 and QR4 all declared new comparisons reported, not used to rescue the H6 rule; archive gaps disclosed.
predeclared_interpretation.independence_claim: FAIL in advance: no previously unscored independent third evaluation period. This factual MISMATCH remains whatever new scores show.

randomness: none; no stochastic fit or seed/split choice

failure_rules.fit: Whole method FAILED on nonconvergence/invalid numerical output; preserve diagnostics, do not score partial prefix or try another penalty.
failure_rules.reference_or_model_failure: Only the affected complete-pair DM/contrast NA; preserve every planned slot and failure reason.
failure_rules.runtime: One attempt in fixed order; preserve completed, interrupted and unattempted slots. Technical interruption cannot be silently retried as another outcome.
failure_rules.source: Hash/bytes/rows/schema/source-spec mismatch stops before scientific scoring. No download or alternate source.
